AEM01.name: ActionDescriptor and ControllerActionDescriptor in MVC/filter context
key_ideas: MVC filters expose ActionDescriptor through filter context.
ControllerActionDescriptor is the MVC-controller-specific descriptor and exposes MethodInfo, ControllerName, ActionName and ControllerTypeInfo.
Endpoint metadata and MVC ActionDescriptor are related but different access paths.
After routing, HttpContext.GetEndpoint().Metadata can expose endpoint-name and route-name metadata.
Minimal APIs rely more directly on Endpoint.Metadata; MVC actions also have MVC action descriptors.
